{"file_path": "{{cwd}}/von-neumann.svg", "content": "<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 560" width="900" height="560" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="900" height="560" fill="#fafbfc"/>
  <text x="450" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#222">Stored-Program Computer (Von Neumann Architecture)</text>

  <!-- ===== CPU ===== -->
  <rect x="300" y="70" width="300" height="240" rx="10" fill="#fff" stroke="#1f6feb" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="450" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#1f6feb">Central Processing Unit · CPU</text>

  <!-- Control Unit -->
  <rect x="325" y="118" width="120" height="160" rx="8" fill="#ddf4ff" stroke="#54aeff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="385" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#0969da">Control Unit</text>
  <text x="385" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#0b5394">CU</text>
  <text x="385" y="262" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#555">Decode · Timing control</text>

  <!-- ALU -->
  <rect x="455" y="118" width="120" height="160" rx="8" fill="#fff8c5" stroke="#d4a72c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="515" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#9a6700">Arithmetic Logic Unit</text>
  <text x="515" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#7a5200">ALU</text>
  <text x="515" y="262" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#555">Arithmetic · Logic</text>

  <!-- Registers -->
  <rect x="330" y="186" width="110" height="56" rx="6" fill="#fff" stroke="#8c959f" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
  <text x="385" y="208" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#444">Register File</text>
  <text x="385" y="224" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#666">Registers / Cache</text>

  <!-- ===== Memory ===== -->
  <rect x="300" y="400" width="300" height="110" rx="10" fill="#fff" stroke="#cf222e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="450" y="428" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#cf222e">Main Memory</text>
  <text x="450" y="452" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#444">Memory cells: instructions and data</text>
  <text x="450" y="470" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#666">(stores programs and data, accessed via one bus)</text>

  <!-- ===== Input ===== -->
  <rect x="40" y="150" width="170" height="120" rx="10" fill="#fff" stroke="#1a7f37" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="125" y="186" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#1a7f37">Input Devices</text>
  <text x="125" y="206" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#444">Input</text>
  <text x="125" y="238" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#666">Keyboard · Mouse · Disk</text>

  <!-- ===== Output ===== -->
  <rect x="690" y="150" width="170" height="120" rx="10" fill="#fff" stroke="#bf3989" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="775" y="186" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#bf3989">Output Devices</text>
  <text x="775" y="206" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#444">Output</text>
  <text x="775" y="238" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#666">Monitor · Printer</text>

  <!-- ===== Bus lines ===== -->
  <!-- Address bus CPU <-> Memory (red) -->
  <path d="M450,320 L450,398" fill="none" stroke="#cf222e" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="420" y="362" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="#cf222e" transform="rotate(-90 420 362)">Address bus</text>

  <!-- Data/control bus label along the bottom -->

  <text x="450" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#555">← Data bus / Control bus →</text>

  <!-- CPU <-> Input (bidirectional-ish: input data in + control out) -->
  <path d="M212,210 L298,210" fill="none" stroke="#1a7f37" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <path d="M212,196 L298,196" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <text x="255" y="184" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#1a7f37">Data (input)</text>
  <text x="255" y="236" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#555">Control</text>

  <!-- CPU <-> Output -->
  <path d="M602,210 L688,210" fill="none" stroke="#bf3989" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <path d="M602,196 L688,196" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <text x="645" y="184" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="#bf3989">Data (output)</text>
  <text x="645" y="236" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#555">Control</text>

  <!-- Memory <-> Input/Output hints: Memory and I/O also exchange data over the bus -->
  <path d="M125,272 L125,300 Q125,340 175,340 L298,340" fill="none" stroke="#8c959f" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="6,4" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <text x="160" y="328" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#666" transform="rotate(-8 160 328)">Bus</text>

  <path d="M775,272 L775,300 Q775,340 725,340 L602,340" fill="none" stroke="#8c959f" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="6,4" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <text x="740" y="328" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#666" transform="rotate(8 740 328)">Bus</text>

  <!-- Stored-program note -->
  <text x="450" y="530" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#666">Core idea: instructions and data are stored together in memory in binary form —— “stored program”</text>
</svg>
"}

files.description: Von Neumann architecture diagram in SVG

content.text:
Created `von-neumann.svg`, a clean von Neumann architecture diagram that includes:

- **CPU (Central Processing Unit)**: contains the control unit CU, the arithmetic logic unit ALU and the register file
- **Main Memory**: labeled "instructions and data stored together" (the stored-program concept)
- **Input devices / output devices**: drawn in green and pink respectively, showing the direction of data flow
- **Bus connections**: CPU and memory linked by the address bus, and CPU and I/O devices linked by data/control lines; arrows mark the direction of data flow
